protocol.capacity: Binary search only on named phase-byte formulas, m<=592; all phases fit1MiB including64KiB reserve and first-pass minimum4rows. No timed rank tuning.
protocol.states: B=[q,g], X,R,P,AP width2; fullouterx/fullresidual; actual validatedQR, nine-block old workspace bound, reprojection, true-check and auxiliary-deflation copies; core buffers and feature packs.
protocol.active_B: B[:,active] replaced with exactly equal B[:,:len(active)]view for the old active orders[0,1]and[0]; all other declared QR/deflation copies retained.
protocol.action: H1 Schur action; each Gaussian tile generated once for both columns, including originalC residual product; per-column mixed triangular solves.
protocol.helper: Verified bitwise-equivalent FIRST8 specialization used for all block and scalar methods, selected before this gate execution.
protocol.timing: Five cyclic single-action repeats. Fresh factor/state rebuilt and freed for each method; setup separately measured, not charged to action ratio. No tracing during timings.
protocol.scope: Component/phase feasibility only. Previousrank32block failure remains; previous GaussianKernel.matmat already shared tiles. No block iteration or end-to-end benefit claim.
